answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on a bond locked by a scarce, non-transferable resource. Each identity must post that bond before it earns anything, and payouts require verified work, so N fake identities cost N bonds plus N genuine deliverables. Bonds are slashed when duplicate output is proven, so a swarm recycling one agent's work forfeits every bond it opened. Identities cannot be rented, so each extra garden of sock puppets sits idle like a jetty holding capital with no traffic. The comet-like burst of identical work also exposes collusion before payouts clear.
